[`_parse_args`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/solveit_client/cli.html#_parse_args)
splits a `sys.argv`-style list into an operation name, positional args,
and keyword args. Boolean flags like `--help` are handled as valueless
switches.

``` python
test_eq(_parse_args(['sic']), (None, [], {}))
test_eq(_parse_args(['sic', '--help']), (None, [], {'help': 1}))
test_eq(_parse_args(['sic', 'dialog', '--help']), ('dialog', [], {'help': 1}))
test_eq(_parse_args(['sic', 'dialog.add_msg', '--help']), ('dialog.add_msg', [], {'help': True}))
test_eq(_parse_args(['sic', 'dialog.add_msg', 'new content', '--msg_type', 'note']),
        ('dialog.add_msg', ['new content'], {'msg_type': 'note'}))
test_eq(_parse_args(['sic', 'dialog.to_xml', '--nums']), ('dialog.to_xml', [], {'nums': True}))
test_eq(_parse_args(['sic', 'dialog.to_xml', '--nums', '--include_output']),
        ('dialog.to_xml', [], {'nums': True, 'include_output': True}))
test_eq(_parse_args(['sic', 'dialog.to_xml', '--nums', '--msg_type', 'code']),
        ('dialog.to_xml', [], {'nums': True, 'msg_type': 'code'}))
test_eq(_parse_args(['sic', 'dialog.to_xml', '--msg_type', 'code', '--nums']),
        ('dialog.to_xml', [], {'msg_type': 'code', 'nums': True}))
test_eq(_parse_args(['sic', 'dialog.add_msg', 'hello', '--nums', '--msg_type', 'note']),
        ('dialog.add_msg', ['hello'], {'nums': True, 'msg_type': 'note'}))
```

`_ns_map` maps CLI namespace strings to their corresponding classes.
[`_to_json`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/solveit_client/cli.html#_to_json)
serializes response objects to JSON using allowlisted keys —
[`Dialog`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/solveit_client/core.html#dialog)
returns `name` and `mode`,
[`Message`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/solveit_client/core.html#message)
returns `id`, `msg_type`, `content`, and `output`.

[`_resolve`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/solveit_client/cli.html#_resolve)
takes an operation string like `"dialog.add_msg"` and keyword args,
constructs the appropriate object chain
([`SolveItClient`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/solveit_client/core.html#solveitclient)
→
[`Dialog`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/solveit_client/core.html#dialog)
→
[`Message`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/solveit_client/core.html#message)),
and returns the resolved method plus remaining kwargs. Infrastructure
args (`url`, `token`, `name`, `id`) are popped and used for object
construction, falling back to env vars (`SOLVEIT_URL`, `SOLVEIT_TOKEN`,
`SOLVEIT_DIALOG`).

``` python
method, clean_kw = _resolve('client.create_dialog', {'url': 'http://localhost:6001', 'name': 'folder/test'})
test_eq(clean_kw, {'name': 'folder/test'})
test_eq(method.__name__, 'create_dialog')
test_fail(_resolve, args=['foo', {}], exc=ValueError)
```

[`sic_cli`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/solveit_client/cli.html#sic_cli)
is the main entry point that ties parsing, resolution, and output
together. It handles three levels of help display: top-level namespace
listing, per-namespace method listing (via `inspect.getmembers`), and
per-method signature display (via `docments`).

## Tests

``` python
res = sic_cli(['sic'])
assert 'client' in res and SolveItClient.__doc__ in res
assert 'dialog' in res and Dialog.__doc__ in res
assert 'message' in res and Message.__doc__ in res
print(res)
```

    Usage: sic <operation> [args]

     client     SolveIt API client
     dialog     Dialog operations
     message    Message operations

``` python
res = sic_cli(['sic', 'dialog', '--help'])
assert 'add_msg' in res
assert 'messages' in res
assert 'find_msgs' in res
assert Dialog.__doc__ not in res

res = sic_cli(['sic', 'client', '--help'])
assert 'create_dialog' in res

res = sic_cli(['sic', 'message', '--help'])
assert 'exec' in res
assert 'update' in res
print(res)
```

    Usage: sic message.<method> [args]

      del_lines       Delete lines from `start_line` to `end_line`.
      delete          Delete this message from its dialog.
      exec            Execute this message and poll until completion or timeout.
      insert_line     Insert `new_str` at line number `insert_line`.
      link            Link to the message.
      num_content     Return content with line numbers.
      replace_lines   Replace lines from `start_line` to `end_line` with `new_content`.
      str_replace     Replace `old_str` with `new_str` in message content (must match exactly once).
      strs_replace    Replace each string in `old_strs` with corresponding string in `new_strs`.
      update          Update message fields and return a `MsgDiff` with the change.

``` python
res = sic_cli(['sic', 'dialog.messages', '--help'])
assert 'All messages' in res

res = sic_cli(['sic', 'dialog.add_msg', '--help'])
for arg, doc in docments(Dialog.add_msg).items():
    if arg in ('self', 'return'): continue
    test(arg, res, operator.in_)

res = sic_cli(['sic', 'dialog.to_xml', '--help'])
for arg, doc in docments(Dialog.to_xml).items():
    if arg in ('self', 'return'): continue
    test(arg, res, operator.in_)

print(res)
```

    Return dialog messages as an XML string.

      --msg_type             optional limit by message type ('code', 'note', or 'prompt')
      --nums                 Whether to show line numbers
      --include_output       Include output in returned dict?
      --trunc_out            Middle-out truncate code output to 100 characters (only applies if `include_output`)?
      --trunc_in             Middle-out truncate cell content to 80 characters?

``` python
# --- setup ---
sic_cli(['sic', 'client.create_dialog', '--name', 'tmp/cli_test2'])

# --- dialog.add_msg ---
res = json.loads(sic_cli(['sic', 'dialog.add_msg', 'hello world', '--name', 'tmp/cli_test2', '--msg_type', 'note']))
test_eq(res['msg_type'], 'note')
test_eq(res['content'], 'hello world')
assert 'id' in res

# --- dialog.messages ---
res = json.loads(sic_cli(['sic', 'dialog.messages', '--name', 'tmp/cli_test2']))
assert isinstance(res, list)
assert len(res) > 0

# --- message.update ---
msg_id = res[0]['id']
res = json.loads(sic_cli(['sic', 'message.update', '--name', 'tmp/cli_test2', '--id', msg_id, '--content', 'updated']))
test_eq(res['content'], 'updated')

# --- message.exec (code cell) ---
code_msg = json.loads(sic_cli(['sic', 'dialog.add_msg', '1+1', '--name', 'tmp/cli_test2']))
res = json.loads(sic_cli(['sic', 'message.exec', '--name', 'tmp/cli_test2', '--id', code_msg['id']]))
assert 'output' in res

# --- edge: unknown namespace ---
test_fail(sic_cli, args=[['sic', 'foo']], exc=SystemExit)

# --- edge: unknown method ---
test_fail(sic_cli, args=[['sic', 'dialog.nonexistent']], exc=SystemExit)

# --- cleanup ---
sic_cli(['sic', 'dialog.delete', '--name', 'tmp/cli_test2'])
```

[`sic`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/solveit_client/cli.html#sic) is
the CLI entry point — a thin wrapper that passes `sys.argv` to
[`sic_cli`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/solveit_client/cli.html#sic_cli)
and prints the result. Wire it up as a console script in
`pyproject.toml`:

``` toml
[project.scripts]
sic = "solveit_client.cli:sic"
```
